description: Run check_cert, check_dns and check_domain_expiry together and return their raw results plus a short summary, the renewal-stall flag and the Let's Encrypt 64-day certificate note (from 2027-02-10). Use it for a full data dump in one call; use domain_grade if you want a single scored A-F answer that also covers email auth and HTTP headers. If one or two sources fail you get partial=true with the rest. Read-only. Costs $0.03 USDC per call via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input or an upstream failure returns an error and is not charged.
